Name: product_version_id
Description: The product_version_id attribute identifies the version of an individual data product.

Name: spacecraft_clock_start
Description: The spacecraft_clock_start attribute provides the value of the spacecraft clock at the beginning of a time period of interest.

Name: spacecraft_clock_stop
Description: The spacecraft_clock_stop attribute provides the value of the spacecraft clock at the end of a time period of interest.

Name: local_true_solar_time
Description: The local_true_solar_time attribute is the local true solar time, as defined in the main PDS4 data dictionary, at the beginning of an observation.

Name: sol_number
Description: The sol_number attibute is the number of the Mars day on which an observation was acquired. Landing day is Sol 0.

Name: ops_token
Description: The ops_token is a code associated with a Phoenix data product that provides information about the command sequence that caused the product to be acquired. The value is a 32-bit unsigned hexadecimal integer expressed in a PDS label as 16#AAAAPCCC#, where: - AAAA is the campaign ID assigned by the sequence planning team, - P is a 4-bit payload ID reserved for use by each instrument team, as defined by the team, and - CCC is the command sequence number, which is set to zero for each new campaign and automatically incremented with each command. The combination of ops_token and sol number should uniquely identify a Phoenix data product.

Name: ops_token_activity
Description: ops_token_activity is the 16-bit activity code (campaign id) from the ops_token, represented as a 4-digit Hex value.

Name: ops_token_payload
Description: ops_token_payload is the 4-bit payload id value of the ops token, represented as a single Hex digit.

Name: ops_token_command
Description: ops_token_command is the 12-bit command sequence number of the ops token, represented as a 3-digit Hex value.

Name: instument_mode_id
Description: The instument_mode_id attribute identifies an instrument-dependent designation of operating mode.

Name: CME
Description: Phoenix MECA Instrument Mode = CME, MECA Control and Measurement Electronics.

Name: COND
Description: Phoenix MECA WCL Instrument Mode = COND, a time-series of electrical conductivity measurements.

Name: COUPONS_TABLE
Description: Phoenix MECA Instrument Mode = COUPONS_TABLE, one of six onboard tables that modify the operation of the MECA flight software.

Name: CP
Description: Phoenix MECA WCL Instrument Mode = CP, a time-series of electrode potential and current chronopotentiometry measurements.

Name: CV
Description: Phoenix MECA WCL Instrument Mode = CV, a time-series of electrode potential and current cyclic voltammetry measurements.

Name: DOX
Description: Phoenix MECA WCL Instrument Mode = DOX, a time-series of dissolved oxygen measurements acquired with an ion selective electrode with CV-style detection.

Name: FRQTEST
Description: Phoenix MECA AFM Instrument Mode = FRQTEST, AFM frequency test.

Name: ISES
Description: Phoenix MECA WCL Instrument Mode = ISES, a time-series of ion selective electrode data.

Name: N/A
Description: Not applicable.

Name: PARAM_VALUE_TABLE
Description: Phoenix MECA Instrument Mode = PARAM_VALUE_TABLE, one of six onboard tables that modify the operation of the MECA flight software.

Name: PT
Description: Phoenix MECA WCL Instrument Mode = PT, a time-series of pressure and temperature measurements.

Name: PWR
Description: Phoenix MECA Instrument Mode = PWR, a time series of voltage and current values provided by the primary MECA 5V (load and logic) and 15V (load and AFM) power supplies.

Name: SCAN
Description: Phoenix MECA TECP or AFM Instrument Mode = SCAN, indicating scanning mode.

Name: STATE_TABLE
Description: Phoenix MECA Instrument Mode = STATE_TABLE, one of six onboard tables that modify the operation of the MECA flight software.

Name: TIPS_TABLE
Description: Phoenix MECA AFM Instrument Mode = TIPS_TABLE, data resulting from initialization and test of the Wheatstone Bridge used to monitor the deflection of the AFM cantilevers. Or, Phoenix MECA Instrument Mode = TIPS_TABLE, one of six onboard tables that modify the operation of the MECA flight software.

Description: The Phoenix_Parameters class is a superclass containing all Phoenix mission classes.
